module: Flowgraph node "Aggregate Attempt" (category once_p_duration, tags activity/mission). Integrates an attempt into the mission's progression (gameplay_missions_progress.aggregateAttempt), saves the data outside career, stops the AI recording and computes the outro text of the highest unlocked default star. Inputs: "attempt" (attemptData), "progressKey" (string, otherwise currentProgressKey then the mission's defaultProgressKey). Outputs: "change" (table), "outroText", "outroTranslation" (translationObject table {txt, context}), "newBestType" (bool, hidden); custom output pins receive the fields of aggregateChange with the same name.
notes: Does nothing without an associated activity (self.mgr.activity is nil).
Outside career, calls gameplay_missions_progress.saveMissionSaveData for the mission; in career, saving is left to career mode.
The outro text first takes careerSetup.starOutroTexts then defaultStarOutroTexts; 'noStarExists' is used when no default star exists or is unlocked.

workOnce.desc: Aggregates the attempt, saves if outside career, stops the AI recording (aiRecording module), computes outroText/outroTranslation and fills change and the custom output pins.
